notes.title: Steam Award Nominations 2019!
notes.content:
The 2019 Steam Autumn Sale is live, and so is the nomination voting for the 2019 Steam Awards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818700/371b9c0065100f61b41517b3c758672d24b6bd78.png[/img]

Did you enjoy returning to the underbelly of Paper City with hard-boiled detective Ted E. Bear? Let us know by voting for Bear With Me: The Lost Robots!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818700/fa786ded801ec8eb98273ef900574c146088e483.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818700/e561ed390a073e5ad4b38ecaaa84b1a9babfb627.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34818700/fa786ded801ec8eb98273ef900574c146088e483.jpg[/img]

 What stood out to you? The unique 2D animated film noir aesthetic? The narrative and "colorful" cast in a gritty world? The classic point-and-click adventure/mystery gameplay? Let us know by voting for for the Steam Awards nominations!

Thanks in advance for any nominations!

notes.title: E3 2019 games every game confirmed
notes.content:
They just keep coming don’t they? A lot of games were announced at E3 2019, things that we didn’t know about, as well as stuff that’s previously announced, or expansions to already released games. Now, to the casual outsider, what we’re doing might seem absolutely nuts, but we thought we’d put together an alphabetical list of all the PC games that have been confirmed to appear at this year’s E3 show. With well over a hundred of them now in the books, the next year or so looks packed.

notes.title: E3 2019 games every game confirmed
notes.content:
A new Baldur’s Gate! That’s a big surprise if I’ve ever seen one. But what if sequels to classic RPGs are not your thing? Well there will be lots of other games, though the big companies will shout the loudest. That doesn’t seem fair as even smaller games deserve some time in the spotlight, because with enough eyes, they could rise to prominence. Then there’s those that have been rumoured, but may not appear. With over 50 games already confirmed to be at the show, we thought we’d put together an alphabetical list of games that have been confirmed to appear at this year’s E3 show.

(more…)

Every year, E3 just has games. Lots of games. Some may just be the next best big thing. With so many big name publishers buzzing for your attention like that persistent fly you just can’t get away from, it’s tricky to know exactly what’s going to be at the show and what isn’t. So we’ve put together a list of the games that have been confirmed to appear at E3 2019.
